name: tracker-notification-delivery
goal: Prove legacy callback identity, durable webhook retry, send-time eligibility, grouped quiet-hour delivery and reminder transitions using synthetic destinations.

evidence: Pinned Tracker 122e190 notifier.js, deliver.js and webhook.js. Prove event keys and delivery envelopes, local callbacks, hub outbox, backoff, stale-event drops, quiet-hour batches and durable replay on synthetic actors.
New delivery service declares method states for scanning, send, retry, pause and restart; the timing helpers do not cover its injected storage and destination boundary.
Sealed 466ff13d93 with all scenario registrations and the matcher recorder. Delivery cases fail on the scaffold with the expected missing delivery assertion.
Ported completion callbacks, webhook outbox, flag and due reminders and Chief of Staff batches. Queue transactions preserve issued requests and receipts.
